description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing Wi-Fi SSID configurations in a web interface, including functions for initializing the page, handling user interactions, validating input, and communicating with backend APIs.

methods.name: page_init
methods.description: Initializes the page with SSID data, creating table rows for each SSID.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of object data, copies data and initializes page.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed data retrieval, stops loading indicator.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Starts the process by resetting current control ID and fetching data.

methods.name: ssid_enable_control
methods.description: Enables or disables an SSID based on checkbox state.

methods.name: hide_control_bar
methods.description: Hides or shows the control bar for SSID configuration.

methods.name: ssid_control
methods.description: Handles user interaction for SSID control menu.

methods.name: _node_control
methods.description: Displays detailed control options for a specific SSID.

methods.name: hide_handler
methods.description: Sets the hidden property for an SSID.

methods.name: select_authtype_select
methods.description: Updates authentication type for an SSID.

methods.name: valid_ssid
methods.description: Validates SSID input for various error conditions.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successfully saving configuration, triggers wireless restart.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during save operation, including logout on 403.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends updated data to API for saving.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Validates inputs and initiates save process.
